source_context: Reflection across a generalized circle (circline), the zero locus of the Hermitian form A|z|^2 + Bz + conj(B)conj(z) + C with A, C real and B complex. Mathlib has no circline object: the identifiers circline, Cline and GeneralizedCircle return no hits in the declaration index, and the circle-versus-line dichotomy is currently written out by hand in at least two places, Analysis/Complex/UpperHalfPlane/FixedPoints.lean and Geometry/Euclidean/Inversion/ImageHyperplane.lean. Mathematics is classical inversive geometry and is not claimed as new; reflect is derived by solving H z = 0 for z in terms of conj z, which is why the fixed-point characterization holds by construction. Statement origin is mixed: the mathematical content is textbook and the target was chosen by a human, while the Lean statements were drafted by the model. Proofs are machine-written. Ported from the standalone repository carlok/inversive-geometry-lean, which pins Mathlib v4.33.0; the module is unchanged apart from the namespace, and is submitted here against v4.33.0-rc1. Two declarations from that repository are deliberately not included. A Verify module consisting of #print axioms commands is omitted because CONTRACT.md section 2 forbids that content and the receiver performs its own axiom audit. A theorem fixedSet_eq_zeroLocus, which restates reflect_eq_self_iff with set-builder notation and whose proof is the former applied unchanged, is omitted as a same-result restatement.
